description:
Old Cumberland Co. Affiliate Program Terms

Brand Introduction

Welcome to Old Cumberland Co., a rustic, vintage-inspired brand with a southern flare, specializing in premium home fragrances. Our products are designed to bring warmth and charm into every home, providing a flameless experience that's perfect for creating a cozy atmosphere. Whether you're sharing our luxurious soy wax melts or our refreshing room & linen sprays, Old Cumberland Co. products embody high-quality craftsmanship and attention to detail.

Product Description

Old Cumberland Co. offers a variety of handcrafted, 100% soy wax melts and clean-burning room & linen sprays, designed to fill your home with delightful and long-lasting fragrances. With a commitment to natural ingredients, our products are eco-friendly, safe for homes with children and pets, and perfect for every season. Each scent is carefully crafted to evoke memories and emotions, transforming any space into a fragrant escape.

Unique Selling Point (USP)

  • Clean-Burning Soy Wax: Our wax melts are made from 100% soy, offering a sustainable, eco-friendly alternative to traditional paraffin wax.
  • Flameless Fragrance: Perfect for those who want the aroma without the flame. Our products are ideal for homes, offices, or places where open flames aren't allowed.
  • Handcrafted in the USA: All our products are crafted with care in small batches, ensuring consistent quality and performance.
  • Southern Charm & Nostalgia: Inspired by the heart of Tennessee, our fragrances are reminiscent of the rustic charm and peaceful allure of the countryside.

Commission Rate & Payment Terms

As an affiliate of Old Cumberland Co., you will earn a 15% commission on every sale referred through your unique affiliate link. We offer flexible payment options, with commissions paid either via PayPal or check, based on your preference.

  • Commission Rate: 15% per sale.
  • Payout Schedule: Payments are processed on the 1st and 15th of each month.
  • Payment Method: Affiliates may choose to be paid via PayPal or a physical check. Please ensure your payment details are accurate to avoid delays.
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: $50. Commissions will roll over until the threshold is met.

Other Information

  • Cookie Duration: Referrals are tracked for 30 days after the first click, meaning you’ll earn a commission if a customer makes a purchase within 30 days of using your affiliate link.
  • Promotional Materials: We will provide you with high-quality banners, product images, and promotional text to help promote Old Cumberland Co. products effectively.
  • Restrictions: Affiliates may not promote Old Cumberland Co. through any misleading claims or unauthorized coupon codes. All promotional efforts must align with the brand’s values and vision.
  • Affiliate Dashboard: You’ll have access to a dashboard where you can track your referrals, commissions, and payouts in real-time.

We value our affiliates and aim to build lasting partnerships that benefit everyone involved. By joining Old Cumberland Co.’s affiliate program, you become a part of our journey to spread warmth and fragrance into homes across the country.
term_and_condition:
Please review the following terms and conditions before applying to the Old Cumberland Co. Affiliate Program:

  1. The Affiliate25 discount code is for affiliate use only and must not be shared with others. Misuse of this code will result in immediate removal from the affiliate program.
  2. Affiliates must generate at least $100 in sales within the first 60 days of signing up to remain active in the program.
  3. This program is designed to reward genuine advocacy for Old Cumberland Co. products. Affiliates found to be participating solely for the discount will be removed from the program.
  4. The affiliate commission is based on the net sale amount after discounts and does not include shipping or taxes.
  5. Old Cumberland Co. reserves the right to modify or terminate the affiliate program at any time.

By signing up for the affiliate program, you agree to abide by these terms and conditions.
